description: This file defines the interface 'ConnectionBuilder', a mutable builder for creating 'Connection' objects with a fluent API in the Eclipse Ditto connectivity model. It contains method signatures for configuring various connection parameters such as ID, name, credentials, URI, status, sources, targets, and other connection-specific settings.

classes.name: ConnectionBuilder
classes.description: A fluent interface for building Connection objects within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Sets the identifier for the Connection.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Sets the name of the Connection.

methods.name: credentials
methods.description: Sets the connection credentials.

methods.name: credentialsFromJson
methods.description: Sets credentials from a JSON object representation.

methods.name: trustedCertificates
methods.description: Sets trusted certificates for the connection.

methods.name: uri
methods.description: Sets the URI for the Connection.

methods.name: connectionStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the Connection.

methods.name: failoverEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables fail-over for the Connection.

methods.name: validateCertificate
methods.description: Enables or disables certificate validation.

methods.name: processorPoolSize
methods.description: Sets the command processor pool size.

methods.name: sources
methods.description: Adds sources to the Connection.

methods.name: targets
methods.description: Adds targets to the Connection.

methods.name: setSources
methods.description: Replaces sources of the Connection.

methods.name: setTargets
methods.description: Replaces targets of the Connection.

methods.name: clientCount
methods.description: Sets how many clients should establish the Connection.

methods.name: specificConfig
methods.description: Adds configuration specific to the ConnectionType.

methods.name: mappingContext
methods.description: Sets the MappingContext for message mapping.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Sets multiple tags for the Connection.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Adds a single tag to the Connection.

methods.name: lifecycle
methods.description: Sets the ConnectionLifecycle.

methods.name: payloadMappingDefinition
methods.description: Sets the payload mapping definition.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the Connection object.
